entry.name: leftClickAction
entry.label: What happens when you left click on the widget.

entry.name: rightClickAction
entry.label: What happens when you right click on the widget.

entry.name: scrollWheelOn
entry.label: Whether scrolling the mouse on the widget changes the current desktop.

entry.name: horizontalScroll
entry.label: Whether horizontal scrolling changes the desktop

entry.name: invertScroll
entry.label: Whether scrolling inverts which desktop is selected

entry.name: desktopWrapOn
entry.label: Whether the desktop navigation stops at the end or wraps around.

entry.name: singleRow
entry.label: Whether the widget displays in a single row, or follows Plasma's configuration.

entry.name: dotStyle
entry.label: What style to use for indicator dots

entry.name: activeDot
entry.label: The unicode character used for the active desktop indicator

entry.name: inactiveDot
entry.label: The unicode character used for the inactive desktop indicator

entry.name: indicatorSizeMode
entry.label: How the widget renders the size of the indicators

entry.name: indicatorCustomSize
entry.label: Indicator size in pixels when indicatorSizeMode is "custom".

entry.name: indicatorCustomColorsOn
entry.label: Allow indicator dot colours to be customised.

entry.name: activeColor
entry.label: Colour of the current desktop's indicator when indicatorCustomColorsOn is "custom".

entry.name: inactiveColor
entry.label: Colour of the other desktop indicators when indicatorCustomColorsOn is "custom".

entry.name: rotateText
entry.label: Whether text labels are rotated when used in a vertical panel
